learning_objective: The learner can calculate system-level cost and latency for model deployment by analyzing compute cost, throughput, token usage, and the impact of parallelism strategies.

common_misconceptions.description: Believing high latency is always a deal breaker when it is often just an annoyance.
Assuming pipeline parallelism reduces latency when it actually increases total latency due to communication overhead.
Thinking higher throughput increases cost when it typically lowers cost per token.
